hotel_name: Camp Wild Retreat At Aravali Valley

positive_snippets: A truly memorable getaway! From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how big, neat, and beautiful the property is. It’s an adventure lover's paradise, boasting a huge selection of activities like zip lining, sky cycling, and rock climbing—there's never a dull moment. The spacious rooms were a comfortable retreat. The food is simple, satisfying, and good, and the staff deserves special mention for their genuine warmth and friendly service. Highly recommend for a fun-filled family or group trip!

We stayed for one night during the first week of Oct 2025, it wan an amazing experience. Food was hygienic and tasty, lemon water welcome drink was too good.

Room was clean with split ACs.

Pool was v clean. The staffs , guides were v polite and offer excellent services.
Lots of activities. Morning trekking was breathtaking..

Its highly recommended. ( Just see the time and season before going, that will make a lots of difference and ensure that the pool is cleaned., asking them to send u recent pic etc.)
My holiday at Camp Wild Retreat was amazing! 🏕️ The rooms were super comfy, the service was top-notch, and the location was just perfect for a getaway. Highly recommend! ✨😊
